SJA-ELECTRIC.title: St John Ambulance — Electric Shock First Aid

ARC-POWERLINES.title: American Red Cross — Power Outage Safety

high_confidence_signals.signal: person is or was in contact with an electrical source
electrical injury with burn, collapse, unresponsiveness, or abnormal breathing

nodes.question_ar: هل ما زال المصاب ملامسًا لمصدر الكهرباء؟
nodes.question_en: Is the person still in contact with the electrical source?

nodes.description_ar: افصل التيار من المصدر الرئيسي إن كان ذلك آمنًا. لا تقترب حتى تتأكد أن الكهرباء انقطعت.
nodes.description_en: Switch off the electricity at the main source if it is safe to do so. Do not approach until you are sure the power is off.

nodes.question_ar: هل تم فصل الكهرباء وأصبح المكان آمنًا؟
nodes.question_en: Has the power been switched off and is the area safe?

nodes.title_en: Stay back and call emergency services.
nodes.description_ar: لا تحاول لمس المصاب أو مصدر الكهرباء إذا لم تستطع عزل التيار بأمان.
nodes.description_en: Do not touch the casualty or electrical source if you cannot safely isolate the power.

nodes.question_ar: هل توجد حروق أو إصابات واضحة؟
nodes.question_en: Are there visible burns or other injuries?

nodes.description_ar: حتى إذا بدا المصاب بخير بعد الصدمة الكهربائية، اطلب تقييمًا طبيًا.
nodes.description_en: Even if the person seems well after the electric shock, seek medical help.

CARDIAC_ARREST_CPR.reason_ar: المصاب غير مستجيب ولا يتنفس بشكل طبيعي
CARDIAC_ARREST_CPR.reason_en: The person is unresponsive and not breathing normally

UNRESPONSIVE_BREATHING.reason_ar: المصاب غير مستجيب لكنه يتنفس بشكل طبيعي
UNRESPONSIVE_BREATHING.reason_en: The person is unresponsive but breathing normally

BURNS.reason_ar: توجد حروق بعد فصل مصدر الكهرباء
BURNS.reason_en: There are burns after the electrical source has been isolated

precedence_rules.rule: Rescuer safety comes first: do not touch a casualty who is still in contact with electricity.
Once contact with electricity is safely broken, assess response and normal breathing.
If the person is unresponsive and not breathing normally, transition immediately to CPR.

never_do.rule_ar: لا تلمس المصاب وهو ما زال ملامسًا لمصدر الكهرباء
never_do.rule_en: Do not touch the casualty while they are still in contact with electricity

never_do.rule_ar: لا تعرّض نفسك للخطر لمحاولة فصل المصاب عن الكهرباء
never_do.rule_en: Do not put yourself at risk trying to separate the casualty from electricity

never_do.rule_ar: لا تقترب من أسلاك كهرباء ساقطة أو مصدر جهد عالٍ
never_do.rule_en: Do not approach fallen power lines or a high-voltage source

open_items: Verify emergency-service numbers per Iraqi region before release.
This MVP intentionally avoids detailed improvised-rescue techniques for separating a casualty from a live source; it prioritizes switching off power and rescuer safety.
High-voltage and fallen-power-line incidents should always remain a stay-back-and-call-emergency-services branch.
